description: Find Godot projects under a directory by locating project.godot files. Use to discover available projects when the user has not specified one; for inspecting a known project, use check_project. recursive:true descends into subdirectories (skipping hidden ones); default false checks only the directory itself and its immediate children. Returns: [{ path, name }], empty array on no matches.

directory.description: Directory to search for Godot projects

name: list_projects
